items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I guess he’s one of the first cool musicians I really got to know a little bit.

ctx.x: Oh, Tadd! Tadd Dameron. These names are so beautiful to me. Each one of them was so great in their own way. Each one was representative of their own art. Tadd was a great arranger and wrote gorgeous songs. What was that gorgeous song he wrote... Oh, it’s so gorgeous I can’t... I know it when I hear it.
“On A Misty Night”? Is that it?
